description: The fifth production F8U-1 later rebuilt as the second XF8U-2 prototype; long-term loan from the National Museum of Naval Aviation delivered from the Vought Aircraft Heritage Foundation in 2011; block check passes within F8U-1 block 140444/140448

Baugher: 140448 was converted to XF8U-2 then to the YF-8C prototype; it was at the Pate Museum of Transportation in Texas and "is now at McAuliffe-Shepard Discovery Center Concord NH". Displayed outdoors at 43.22425 -71.53280 beside the science centre. BuNo block check passes.
